flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, with the party favoured to win the chamber. The projected seat count is now 55-45, up from 54-46, and Democrats gain control. [[South Carolina]] is a newly predicted flip after a sharp rise for the Democrat Annie Andrews, and the Democrat Josh Turek also gained sharply in [[Iowa]], another predicted flip.
summaries.governor: The biggest moves came in three races Polymarket odds now show as predicted flips: [[Georgia]], [[Nevada]] and [[Ohio]]. The Democrats Keisha Lance Bottoms, Aaron Ford and Amy Acton each saw a sharp rise in their chances. In Florida, the Republican Byron Donalds also gained sharply, though that race is not shown as a predicted flip.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show a sizable gain in the Democrats' chances of winning control of the House. The projected seat count moved to 253-182, up from 251-184, which would mean Democrats gain control, with [[CO-05 (Colorado Springs & Fountain)]] and [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]] among the newly predicted flips. In [[NC-03 (Greenville & Jacksonville)]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Raymond Smith Jr. gained ground sharply over the Republican Greg Murphy.
